comment: Apologised and announced the escalation correctly (no promise, no reason given). Did not acknowledge the customer's mention of leaving for Orange.
The rules have the answer (espace client > Mon compte, IBAN, applies to the next bill) but the advisor said it found nothing; the 5-day refund rule it quoted is for double debits.
First answer off topic (payment in instalments). Never gave the full breakdown. Wrong: 49 EUR closure fee applied to the mobile line (contracts.md: boxes only). Deflected the offer question.
Correct breakdown 24,99 + 5,99 + 3,99 = 34,97 EUR and kept to it when the customer doubted. Then sent an offer question to the espace client instead of presenting offers.
Invented that the old SIM was lost and the line suspended, and claimed it as done. Contradicted the customer. First answer (how to activate) was correct; escalation announced.
First reply repeated the customer's own sentence. No troubleshooting as the outage procedure requires. Ignored the customer's plan to leave for SFR. Escalation announced.
Never gave the lost-SIM procedure (free suspension, new SIM 10 EUR, 3 working days); confused it with termination fees. Invented a call-back 'demain matin'.
Right to ask before changing the payment method, but then said it had no information although the procedure exists. Repeated non-answer to a demanding customer.

Correct first answer, then told the customer to contact customer service (they are on the phone with it) and wrongly said the activation code is the RIO code (RIO is for keeping the number elsewhere).
First offered to suspend the line (not asked). Then the correct activation procedure, then guesses about where the code is printed. Not direct enough for an impatient customer.
